tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rnam par bshad pa rdo rje gur rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o
༄༅/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rnam par bshad pa rdo rje gur rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rnam par bshad pa rdo rje gur rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhāṃ/ na mo gu ru bh+ya/ na mo badz+ra sa twa ya/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rnam par bshad pa rdo rje gur rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya chen shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing / /lung rigs rta bdun 'gros kyis legs bsgrod nas/ /gdul bya gling bzhi'i gnas kun gsal mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma pad+mo'i gnyen la 'dud/ /brgyud pa gangs ri'i phreng ltar rab mdzes shing / /snyan brgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar ma chad par/ /rgyud don bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa yi/ /srol gnyis gsal mdzad brgyud pa'i tshogs la 'dud/ /in+d+ra ni la chu shel ltar dkar gser dang pad+ma ra ga margad lta bu'i sku mdog mdzes pa la/ /re re'ang rnam thar zhal 'dzin stong nyid dag pa'i phyag na nad rnams 'joms mdzad dbang phyug stsol ba'i phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /rab dkar rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab mdzes bsdu dngos zhabs kyis bdud bzhi mnan te gar gu'i nyams ldan sku lus la/ /dga' ba ster ba'i yum rnams kyis 'khyud brgyad brgyad 'khor gyi bskor ba'i he ru ka dpal khro chags lnga la 'dud/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis blo gros gsal mdzad cing / /'jig rten dbang phyug sgrol ma la sogs pas/ /phun tshogs rgyud 'grel grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ma hā ka las bar chad bsrung du gsol/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can khrod 'dir yang / /rgyud 'di gsal mdzad mang du byon zin mod/ /rdo rje'i phug rjes skud pas 'jal ba bzhin/ /dam pa'i gsung rjes 'brangs nas rgyud don 'chad/ /'bum lnga'i rgyud chen don bsdus rdo rje'i tshig /rtog dka'i snying po zab cing dpag dka' ba/

/rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud don la/ /rnam par rol pa'i rnam bshad bdag gis bri// ༈ //de la 'dir/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di 'chad pa la don gnyis te/ gang gis gtan la 'bebs par byed pa spyi'i don dang / gang gtan la dbab par bya ba gzhung gi don no/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ de'i mtshan gyi don/ rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag rgyud kyis mngon par rtogs pa skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ de la 'jig rten rnam gnyis mthong / /rnal 'byor pa dang phal pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba dang / blo bsgyur ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma yin la/ de la/ dman pa mu stegs byed dang / mchog gyur sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' gnyis las/ 'di ni phyi ma'o/ /de la yang / rang nyid kyi don du zhi ba'i myang 'das tsam thob par 'dod pa'i theg dman dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob par 'dod pa'i theg pa chen po gnyis las/ phyi ma yin no/ /de la yang / rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'di ni phyi ma'o/ /de la yang / gang zag gi blo yi dbye bas bzhi ste/ 'di nyid las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde bzhi las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang / thabs spros pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab spros med kyi cha gtso bor ston pa shes rab kyi rgyud/ cha mnyam par ston pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum las/ 'di gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang / thog mar gsungs shing bshad gzhir gyur pas na rtsa rgyud dang / rjes las byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pas na bshad rgyud gnyis las/ 'di ni bshad pa'i rgyud do/

/de la'ang / bye brag so so'i bshad pa'i rgyud dang / spyi thun mong gi bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis las/ 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa bye brag so so'i bshad pa'i rgyud yin te/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i tshig dang don gyi cha mtha' dag bsdus pas don bsdus pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir dang / rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i mi gsal ba gsal bar byed/ ma tshang kha skong / tshul mi 'dra ba/ don bsdus pa/ cha mthun pas nges pa bskyed pa/ tshig don rnam par 'byed pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mtshan don la gnyis/ mtshan bsgyur zhing bshad pa dang / phyag bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsgyur ba dang / bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa las/ 'di ni saṃskri ta ste legs par sbyar ba'i skad du/ ar+ya zhes pa bod skad du 'phags pa/ ḍā ki ni zhes pa mkha' 'gro ma/ badz+ra rdo rje/ pañja ra gur/ ma hā chen po/ tan tra rgyud/ rā dza rgyal po/ kalpa rtag pa/ na ma zhes bya ba zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa bshad pa la dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ rgyud kyi slad du mtshan smos pas gang zag dbang po rab kyis rgyud kyi don thams cad khong du chud/ 'bring gis brjod bya ngos zin/ tha mas kyang mtshan don 'brel bar shes pa'o/ /rgya skad smos pas khungs btsun/ bod skad smos pas go sla/ gnyis ka smos pas legs par sbyar ba'i skad la bag chags 'jog lo ts+tsha ba'i drin dran pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa bsdus don la/ mtshan gdags pa'i yul rgyud 'di nyid do/ /btags pa'i mtshan dngos ni/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa zhes pa'o/ /don de la mtshan de 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ brjod bya mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur yin pa'i phyir/ rjod byed de ston pa'i rgyud la'ang de skad ces btags pa ste/ rjes grub can gyi ming ngo /

/gsum pa tshig don ni/ 'phags pa ni/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos las ring du 'phags pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni/ chos kyi sku nam mkha' ltar mi rtog par nam mkha' dang mnyam pas mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /gzugs kyi sku gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du khyab par 'gro bas mkha' 'gro ma ste/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /rdo rje ni/ stong pa nyid de shes rab kyi rang bzhin no/ /gur ni/ drwa ba las 'brel pa ste/ phan tshun khyab par gyur pa'i ye shes te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po ste thabs so/ /de ltar na thabs shes rab gnyis su med pas rdo rje gur zhes pa ste thabs kyi rgyud do/ /rgyud ni/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum rgyun chags zhing 'brel bas rgyud do/ /rgyal po ni/ rgyu'i rgyud rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang / thabs kyi rgyud blo bur gyi dri ma sbyong ba dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud 'bras bu grub pa las mi nyams pas rgyal po'o/ /chen po ni/ 'di'i gong na gzhan med pas so/ /brtag pa ni don dam par brjod du med kyang / kun rdzob tu rtog pas brtags nas brjod pas na brtag pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ chos kun gzugs can ma yin yang / /gzugs su yang ni 'di ru brtags/ /chos kun tshig gi spyod yul min/ /sgra ru yang ni 'di ru brtags/ /de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di la/ /rtog pas brtags pa yin par brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni/ brjod bya rjod byed ston pa'i rgyud kyi ming de skad ces bya ba yin zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa gzhir bzhag yul gang la na kyai rdo rje la'o/ /de la/ kyai ni bod cing bskul ba ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po yin la/ rdo rje ni stong pa nyid rtog pas mi phyed pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang zag gang gis na/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ya ta pa gha ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis so/ /gang gi tshe na/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa zhes bya ba 'di/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'i thog mar ro/ /dgos pa ni/ rgyud 'di bsgyur ba mthar phyin pa'i ched du'o/ /mtshan de ldan gyi rgyud la/ gzhung tshad dang / bzhugs tshul dang / mdo rgyas kyi rim pa gsum las/ gzhung tshad ni/ sh+lau ka stong phrag gcig dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshad du bzhugs shing / le'u bco lnga/ brtag pa ni gcig go /bzhugs tshul la/ gzhug pa'i go rim/ 'khrugs kyi tshul/ skye ba'i rim pa gsum las/ rgyud 'di ni/ gang zag shes rab kyi rlom pa rnams/ bla ma med par rgyud la rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir/ rgyud rab tu dkrugs te gsungs pas na/ 'khrugs kyi tshul du gnas so/ /mdo rgyas ni/ le'u dang pos mdor bstan/ le'u gnyis pa man chad kyis rgyas par bshad pas/ mdo rgyas gnyis su gnas so/ /gsum pa rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag ni/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ yi ge dang ni yan lag dang / /bsdus pa'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas dang de bzhin mthar thug pa/ /gdams ngag rnam pa drug gis ni/ /rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan bir+wa pas/ gdams ngag drug gis 'chad de/ de la gdams ngag drug ni/ brjod bya don gyi gdams ngag gsum dang / rjod byed sgra'i gdams ngag gsum ste drug don gyi gdams ngag gsum ni/ spyi'i don du bshad pa/ sbas pa'i don du bshad pa/ mthar thug gi don du bshad pa gsum mo/ /spyi don la/ pha rol tu phyin pa spyi dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa spyi'i don du bshad pa gnyis/ sbas don la/ rang byin rlabs kyi sbas don dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas don du bshad pa gnyis/

mthar thug pa'i don la/ spyi don gyi mthar thug dang / sbas don gyi mthar thug pa'i don du bshad pa gnyis/ de ltar brjod bya don gyi gdams ngag gsum las phye bas drug rjod byed sgra'i gdams gsum ni/ yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa/ yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa/ bsdus don man ngag gi bshad pa dang gsum/ de las bco brgyad du phye na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyi don du bshad pa la/ yan lag yi ge man ngag gi bshad pa gsum/ de bzhin du/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i spyi don sogs gzhan lnga la'ang gsum gsum ste/ sdom pas drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe/ brjod bya don gyi gdams ngag gsum po de/ gzhung gi tshig don la/ brjod bya so so sbyar bas 'chad pa dang / gzhung tshig re re la'ang bshad thabs yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ ci rigs par sbyar nas 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis yod la/ bshad thabs des/ gzhung gi brjod bya gang / rjod byed gang gis/ tshul ji ltar 'chad pa sogs ni/ 'og tu gzhung so so'i steng du spro bar bya'o// ༈ //bzhi pa rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ mdor bsdus na/ rgyu'i rgyud/ thabs kyi rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum du 'gyur te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /rgyun de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrogs pa yi rab phye ba'o/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya bar brjod/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de la/ rgyu'i rgyud rten gyi gang zag rigs bzhi/ thabs kyi rgyud la/ skal ba dman pa rim gyis 'jug pa dang / skal ba dang ldan pa gcig char 'jug pa gnyis/ rim 'jug la/ spyod pa rim can dang / lta ba rim can gnyis/ lta ba la/ thun mong gi lta ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba la 'jug pa gnyis/ gcig char 'jug pa la/ smin grol gnyis/

grol byed la/ mchog dang / thun mong bsgrub pa/ gnyis ka'i grogs dang gsum/ mchog bsgrub pa la/ lta ba bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu dang lnga/ thun mong bsgrub pa la/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg las tshogs dang lnga/ gnyis ka'i grogs la/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig sems brtan pa thob pa/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig dang gsum/ yang na/ lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis/ de re re la yan lag drug drug ste/ grol byed lam la mngon rtogs bcu bzhi/ 'bras bu'i rgyud la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sa bcu gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu bshad gzhi sku bzhi dang / 'chad byed yan lag lngas gtan la 'bebs te/ rgyud kyi don ma lus pa 'dir 'dus so/ /des na/ gang zag gi rgyud la mngon par rtogs pa skye ba'i go rim de ltar yin yang / rgyud 'dir mngon par rtogs pa de dag shin tu 'khrugs nas gsungs pa de/ bla ma'i man ngag gis 'khrugs bsdebs nas 'chad dgos pas/ de la gnyis/ le'u gang nas gang 'byung dang / /rgyud rgyal mchog 'di dkrugs mod kyi/ /brjod bya bsdebs te brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal mnga' nas gsungs pa/ le'u dang po gleng gzhi ste/ /rgyud kun gyi ni mdor bstan yin/ /mchod dang dkyil 'khor tshad dang ni/ /spyod lam tshon rnams rigs lngas phye/ /'byung po 'dul ba stobs po che/ /rdzogs pa'i rim dang stobs kyis bsgrub/ /'bum lnga tshad dang sangs rgyas gar/ /dgos pa dang bcas gnyis pa bstan/ /gtor ma dang ni ming gi dbang / /gnyis kyis le'u gsum pa 'o/ /rgyud grangs rgyas bsdus dgos par bcas/ /sgom gnas sku gsung thugs phyag rgya/ /lha mo'i sku yi phyag rgya dang / /mkha' 'gro'i sgra bsgrub ma rgyud ni/ /bsdus pa'i dgos dang bdag med ma'i/ /sgrub thabs sngags bcas rig dbang dang / /bskyed rdzogs kun gyi rnam gzhag dang /

/grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa dang / /mi bskyod pa yi mngon rtogs dang / /khro bcu'i cho gas bzhi pa bsdus/ /sems dpa' sum rtsegs bsgom pa dang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i mchod pa dang / /rigs lnga rgyas bsdus dbye ba dang / /rigs bsdus pa yi rnam gzhag dang / /phyag mtshan dag par bcas pa yis/ /le'u lnga pa bstan pa yin/ /rjes dran gsum gyis dam tshig pa/ /bskyed de phyag rgya bzhis gdab ste/ /des ni chos su bshad pa yin/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs spro bsdu dang / /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor rgya khyon dang / /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug pa dang / /phreng ba bzlas pa'i phan yon dang / /rim gnyis phan yon drug pa 'o/ /yan lag drug sngags bcas pa dang / /gzhal med khang bskyed lha dgod dang / /dbang bzhi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ /phan yon dang bcas bdun pa 'o/ /glus bskul sku gsung skye mched drug /byin rlabs sngags bcas rtsod spong bcas/ /rdo rje sgrol ma pha rol phyin/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa'i thabs/ /nang dang phyi yi sbyin sreg dang / /thun mong mchog gi 'bras bu dang / /phyag rgya sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /rigs lnga'i bstod pa bsdus pa dang / /dkyil 'khor thig tshon sa chog dang / /sbyin sreg gis ni brgyad pa bsdus/ /rab tu gnas dang drag shul bsgrub/ /rigs bzhi zhal dang sku mdog dang / /rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i yon/ /rigs lnga'i sngags dang phan yon bcas/ /dkyil 'khor dbyibs dang gtso bo'i rgyan/ /phyag rgya bsten tshul dgu pa 'o/ /spyod pa dang ni skye mched drug /bsgom pa'i phan yon bcu pa 'o/ /las bzhi lha dang bsam gtan dang / /phyag rgya sngags bcas bcu gcig pa/ /sgrub pa'i gnas su tshogs gnyis gsag /tshad med bzhi dang bcas pa dang / /srung 'khor gzhal yas mngon byang lnga/ /bdag med ma yi sgrub thabs dang / /skye mched sku gsung byin rlabs dang / /ye shes dgug dang dbang bskur dang /

/mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /bzlas pa'i man ngag bcu gnyis pa/ /thabs dang shes rab rgyud kyi grangs/ /rgyud sde spyi yi dgongs pa dang / /gnyis med sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /de la rjes su yi rang dang / /spyod pa dam tshig bla ma ni/ /mnyes bya 'thad bcas bcu gsum pa/ /'bring gi dngos grub ril bu sogs/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i 'thad pa dang / /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / /mngon spyod khro bcu'i srung 'khor dang / /rdzogs rim sangs rgyas sa dang ni/ /rim gnyis rgyu bcas sangs rgyas sa/ /'jam dpal rdzogs rim cung zad bcas/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel mtshon cha dang / /rol mo bdug spos phyag rgya gar/ /phyi nang sbyin sreg nye rgyu dang / /rkang stabs lag stabs 'dug stangs dang / /bzhin gyi bsgyur tshul glu dang ni/ /mchod pa'i bya bas bcu bzhi pa'o/ /he ru ka gsum kur ku le/ /gleng gzhi las rgyas rnal 'byor bcu/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dang / /nye rgyu dbang gi rkang grangs dang / /dam tshig bde gshegs bstod par bcas/ /rje btsun ji ltar lta ba dang / /de la bkur ba'i rim pa ste/ /rgyud kun gyi ni don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ gnyis pa ni/ yang gsungs pa/ le'u dang pos gleng gzhi yi/ /tshul gyis rgyud kun don bsdus yin/ /gnyis pa dang ni bzhi pa yis/ /brtag pa'i grangs dang rgyas bsdus so/ /bcu gsum rgyud grangs bco lnga pa'i/ /gleng gzhi spyi yi rjod byed yin/ /drug pa dang ni bcu gsum pa/ /bcu bzhi'i phyogs gcig rgyu rgyud yin/ /brgyad pa dang ni bcu bzhi par/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid sa chog yin/ /bum pa sta gon dgu pa las/ /gnyis pa brgyad pas thig dang tshon/ /gnyis pa dgu pas tshad dang dbyibs/ /gnyis lnga brgyad dang bcu gnyis pas/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga yin/ /bzhi pa bdun pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa yis dbang bstan pa/

/brgyad pas gsol gdab dgu pas yon/ /mdor na gnyis gsum bzhi lnga dang / /bdun dang brgyad dang dgu pa dang / /bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga ste/ /brgyad kyi cha yis smin byed bstan/ /drug dang bcu gsum bcu bzhi pas/ /thog mar lta ba bstan pa yin/ /bzhi pa dang ni bcu gnyis pas/ /spyi dang so so'i gnas bstan no/ /brgyad pa dang ni bcu gnyis pas/ /rim gnyis spyi yi mngon rtogs bstan/ /bskyed rim spyi'i mngon rtogs ni/ /le'u bzhi pas bstan pa yin/ /gnyis pa lnga pa bcu gnyis pas/ /sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis gsag pa bstan/ /bzhi pa bcu gnyis bcu bzhi pas/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bstan pa yin/ /yan lag drug sngags bcas pa ni/ /le 'u bdun pas bstan pa yin/ /gnyis pa lnga pa drug pa dang / /bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa dang / /bcu gnyis pa yis gzhal yas khang / /bzhi pa lnga pa drug bdun pa/ /dgu pas gtso bo'i mngon rtogs bstan/ /bco lnga'i cha yis rdo rje gsum/ /bzhi pa bcu gnyis rje btsun ma/ /sems dpa' sum rtsegs phyag rgya bzhi/ /lnga pa dang ni drug pas bstan/ /gnyis drug dgu pa bcu gnyis pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa bstan/ /bzhi brgyad dgu pa bcu bcu gnyis/ /gnas dgu byin gyis brlabs pa bstan/ /de dag yan lag gnyis pa yin/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu gnyis pas/ /dbang dang bdud rtsi myang ba yin/ /lnga dgu bcu gnyis bcu bzhi pas/ /lnga pa mchod pa bstan pa yin/ /dgu pa bcu gnyis bco lnga pas/ /yan lag drug pa bstan pa yin/ /de ltar le'u bcu gnyis kyis/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa bcu bzhi pas/ /rang byin brlabs pa'i rim pa bstan/ /gnyis drug brgyad pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bdun pa'i dbang gi cha tsam gyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bstan pa yin/ /le 'u drug gis rdzogs rim mo/ /dmigs med phyogs kyi rdzogs rim ni/ /sngar gyi lta bas bstan pa yin/ /gnyis dang dgu pas stobs bsgrub ste/

/drod ni thob par byed pa 'o/ /grub brtag le 'u bzhi pa ste/ /spyod pa bcu pas nye rgyu ni/ /bcu bzhi bco lngas bstan pa yin/ /bzhi drug dgu pas bzlas pa bstan/ /brgyad dang bcu gcig bcu bzhi pas/ /sbyin sreg dgu pas rab gnas bstan/ /gtor ma le 'u gsum pa ste/ /gnyis dang bzhi pa brgyad bcu gcig /bcu bzhi bco lngas las tshogs bstan/ /gnyis pa dang ni lnga pa dang / /bdun pa dang ni brgyad pa dang / /bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa yis dam tshig bstan/ /bzhi pa drug pa brgyad pa dang / /bcu bzhi pa yis 'bras bu 'o/ /de ltar sdom tshig rnam gnyis kyis/ /rgyud kun khong du chud par nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa de dag rgyud kyi gzhung so so dang sbyar nas khog sgrig ste/ rgyas par bla mas bshad par bya'o// //gnyis pa gang gtan la dbab par bya ba gzhung gi don la gsum/ le'u dang pos gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud kyi lus mdor bstan pa dang / gang bshad pa'i chos phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rjes su yi rang bas mjug rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don no/ /dang po ni/ le'u dang po 'di'i rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag las/ brjod bya spyi dang / sbas pa dang / mthar thug gsum ka 'jug la/ rjod byed yan lag gi don gtso bo yin la/ yi ge dang man ngag gi don yang cung zad 'jug go /mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyud gsum ka dang 'brel la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi gang du phan 'dogs na/ rgyud rgyas pa'i gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga don bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'chad la/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa 'di ni/ tshig don rnam par phye bas phan 'dogs so/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis/ don dngos dang / le'u'i ming ngo / /dang po la lnga/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ dus/

ston pa/ 'khor/ 'khor gyi phrin las chos phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gtso bor rgyu'i rgyud la bzhugs par bstan pa dang / gtso bor thabs kyi rgyud la bzhugs par bstan pa dang / gtso bor 'bras bu'i rgyud la bzhugs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi tshul gyis 'byung ba lngar bsdus pa la bzhugs pa dang / sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la bzhugs pa dang / sbyang gzhi gtso bor sbyong byed dang bcas pa snod bcud la bzhugs pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha' ni/ nam mkha'i khams so/ /bem bcas ni/ sra ba'i phyir sa'i khams so/ /dwang ba ni 'od gsal ba'i phyir chu'i khams so/ /go skabs med pa ni/ bsreg pa'i go skabs las gzhan med pa'i phyir me'i khams so/ /'byed pa ni/ 'byung ba rnams smin cing dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i phyir rlung gi khams so/ /de ltar na/ nam mkha' bem bcas dwangs ba dang / /go skabs med dang 'byed pa dang / /zhes pa'i tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'dis 'byung ba lnga la sbyar nas/ de'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gang yin ston pa la gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud la sbyar ba dang / sbyong byed lam la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ snod dang / bcud do/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha' sogs kyi don/ nam mkha' ni nam mkha' stong pa ste/ snod snga ma zhig phyi ma ma chags pa'i stong pa bstan no/ /de'i steng du 'byed pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags pa/ de'i steng du go skabs med pas me'i dkyil 'khor chags pa/ de'i steng du dwangs bas chu'i dkyil 'khor chags pa/ de'i steng du bem bcas kyi sa'i dkyil 'khor chags pa bstan te/ de la 'byung ba bzhi kun rdzob/ nam mkha' ni don dam ste/ bden pa gnyis po de la'ang ston pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes bsgrub bya'i rig pa chos kyi sku chen po de thams cad du snang ba thams cad der khyab pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/

/bzhugs tshul 'di bshad pa 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /bcud la yang gnyis las/ bcud bskyed pa'i rim pa mngal gyi sngon 'gro la sbyar na/ nam mkha' ni ma'i mngal gyi nam mkha'o/ /de la pha ma'i dbang po gnyis reg pas sa/ byang sems gsher ba chu/ bskyod pa me/ rtsa gnas nas byang chub kyi sems g.yo ba rlung ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ reg pa sra ba'i bag chags kyis/ /sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur/ /byang sems gsher ba'i rnam pa las/ /chu yi khams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskyod pa las ni drod skye ste/ /'gro ba rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcud kyi gnyis pa mngal la sogs pa skye gnas bzhir rim gyis 'grub pa la sbyar na/ rnam par shes pa nam mkha' dang dbyer med pa la rlung skye la/ de las me skye shing / de las chu skye la/ de las sa skye ba'i don te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ rnam shes las ni skyes pa rlung / /de las me ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las dbang chen 'byung ba ste/ /de las phung po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las ye shes skye ba ste/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor bas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'khor ba snod bcud la yang ston pa chos sku bzhugs so/ /zhes sngar ltar sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa sbyong byed lam la sbyar ba la gnyis te/ bskyed rim la sbyar ba dang / rdzogs rim la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa'i rgyu la sbyar ba dang / brten pa lha la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs lugs bzlog la sbyar na/ nam mkha' sogs kyis/ nam mkhas ni chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa bstan/ de'i nang du bem bcas kyis sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du dwangs bas chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du go skabs med pas me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du 'byed pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de las gzhal yas khang du gyur pa de/

'di ni mngal gyi sngon 'gro dang / 'khor lo bzhi'i go rim la dgongs pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /ji ltar rigs pas byin za dang / /lha rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang / /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'di nyid kyi gzhung ma 'khrugs pa/ nam mkha' bem bcas dwangs ba dang / /go skabs med dang 'byed pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'byung ba lugs 'byung las bskyed pa'i dbang du byas na/ chos 'byung gi nam mkha'i nang du/ mas rim du sbyar bas/ 'byed pas rlung / go skabs med pas me/ dwangs bas chu/ bem bcas kyi sa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan la/ 'di ni mngal gyi dngos gzhi dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'byung ba chags pa la dgongs pa ste/ 'og le'u bcu gnyis par/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /zhes pa nas/ dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha la sbyar ba ni/ nam mkha' ni rin chen 'byung ldan/ bem bcas sa ste rnam par snang mdzad/ dwang bas chu ste mi bskyod pa/ go skabs med pas me ste 'od dpag med/ 'byed pas rlung ste don yod grub pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ sra ba gti mug chos kyi phyir/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas shes so/ /yang yum gyi rnam pa la sbyar na/ nam mkha' ni nam mkha'i dbang phyug ma/ sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu ma mā kī me gos dkar mo/ rlung sgrol ma ste/ ji skad du/ sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /chu yi khams ni ma mā kī /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ni/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de nyid rigs so so ba'i lha dgu la sbyar na/ dbus dang phyogs kyi gtso bo dang gau ri la sogs pa rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang mthun la/ mtshams kyi pu ka si la sogs pa rnams ni yum bzhi dang mthun te/

rtsa rgyud las/ sa ni pu ka sir bshad pa/ /gang phyir gti mug sra ba nyid/ /sku ni rnam snang nyid gsungs pa/ /zhes pa dang / gang phyir gzugs ni sra ba nyid/ /dkar mo rnam snang nyid gsungs pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas shes so/ /de lta bu'i rten dang brten pa la'ang ston pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur bzhugs so zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngags la sbyar na/ sa ni lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ chu ni snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo/ me ni mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ rlung ni spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bstan la/ de la brten pa'i rtsa gsum dang bcas pa ni kun rdzob yin la/ de'i 'bar 'dzag la brten nas rang 'byung gi ye shes skyes pa ni nam mkha' don dam ste/ saṃ ṭir/ e ni sa ru shes par bya/ /waṃ ni chu ru shes par bya/ /ma ni me ru brjod par bya/ /ya ni rlung gi rang bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rtsa rgyud las/ e yi rnam pas lha mo spyan/ /waṃ gyis rnam pas bdag mar brjod/ /ma ni lha mo gos dkar mo/ /ya yi rnam pas sgrol mar brjod/ /ces gsungs pas shes pa yin no/ /des na/ rdzogs rim rang byin rlabs la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sbyar na/ rigs lnga'i sgrub pa pos bram ze mo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ spyan ma la sogs par bskyed pa dang / 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ rdo rje dang pad+ma reg pa sra ba sa/ byang sems gsher ba chu/ bskyod pa me/ rtsa thams cad nas byang sems dbang gi gnas su g.yo ba rlung ste kun rdzob/ de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes pa ni don dam nam mkha' ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bo la ka ko la sbyor bas/ /reg pa sra ba'i chos kyi ni/ /sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ bde ba nam mkha' nyid kyi khams/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis shes so/ /de ltar bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa lhan cig skyes pa la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs so zhes snga ma bzhin sbyar ro/

/des na/ nam mkha' sogs kyi rdo rje'i tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di la/ snod la gcig bcud la gnyis/ bskyed rim gyi rten la gnyis/ brten pa la gnyis/ rdzogs rim la gnyis te/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bshad pa dgur gsungs la/ rgyas par na bsam gyis mi khyab pa rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi bskyed rim la bzhugs pa ni/ sna tshogs ni dngos po sna tshogs te snang ba'i cha'o/ /rdo rje ni rang bzhin stong pa dngos med kyi cha'o/ /gzhir gnas khang ni snod kyis bsdus pa/ sems can gyi khams ni bcud kyis bsdus pa/ yid du 'ong ba ni lam bsgrub pa'i skal ba yod pa ste sbyang gzhi'o/ /de dag sbyong byed lam la sbyar na/ sna tshogs ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ rdo rje ni ye shes kyi tshogs/ gzhir gnas khang ni gzhal yas khang pa/ sems can gyi khams ni dam tshig sems dpa'/ yid du 'ong pa ni ye shes sems dpa' gzhug go /yang na/ sna tshogs ni tshogs gnyis bsag pa/ rdo rje ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ gzhi ni gzhal yas khang / gnas khang ni ye shes pa gzhug pa'i gnas yin pas na dam tshig pa/ sems can ni sa twa ste sems dpar 'gyur la/ de ni ye shes sems dpa'/ yid du 'ong ba ni bskyed chog yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yang gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i rgyu la sbyar na/ sna tshogs ni sngar dang 'dra la/ rdo rje'i gzhi ni sa'i dkyil 'khor/ gnas khang ni chu'i dkyil 'khor/ sems can ni drod dang bcas pa'i phyir me'i dkyil 'khor/ yid 'ong ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ de las gzhal yas khang grub bo zhes bya ba'o/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed de la yang ston pa chos kyi sku rdo rje gur bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ don bsdu ba/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snod ni khams gsum snod kyis bsdus pa/ sems can ni khams gsum gyi bcud kyis bsdus pa/

'jig rten ni khams gsum snod bcud kyis bsdus pa ste/ de dag ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ zhar la sbyong byed ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten ni bskyed rim gyi rten dang / bcud kyi sems can ni brten pa lhas sbyong la/ yang na snod rten bskyed rim dang / sems can bcud ni brten pa rdzogs rim ste bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyang gzhi sa steng dang / sa 'og dang / bar snang sa bla ste snod kyi 'jig rten dang / yid dang lus dang ngag dang ni lus ngag yid gsum dang ldan pa'i bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi sbyang gzhi'o/ /de dag sbyong byed ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pas lus kyi dpral bar sku rdo rje mkha' spyod sbyong / ngag gi mgrin par gsung rdo rje sa spyod/ yid kyi snying khar thugs rdo rje sa 'og spyod sbyong la/ rdzogs rim sngags ltar sbyar na/ lus kyi lte bar sku rdo rje sa 'og spyod/ yid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo thugs rdo rje sa spyod/ ngag gi longs spyod 'khor lo gsung rdo rje mkha' spyod sbyong / chos su bshad na/ ngag gi zhu ba gsung rdo rje sa 'og spyod/ lus kyi bde ba sku rdo rje sa spyod/ yid kyi mi rtog pa thugs rdo rje mkha' spyod sbyong ngo / /des na/ 'og na mar la sku gsum gyi gnas mi 'dra ba gsungs pa'ang dgongs pa mi 'gal bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar snod bcud gnyis po de yang / bden pa gnyis su bsdu bar bstan pa ni/ gcig ni don dam par dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i sems nyid du ro gcig pa'o/ /gnyis ni kun rdzob snang ba dang stong pa gnyis sam/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis sam/ chos can dang chos nyid kyi tshul gnyis su snang ba'o/ /snga ma gcig gi dpe ni/ mkha' ste nam mkha' dang 'dra bar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi dpe ni bde bas ste chos can 'khor ba'i bde ba dang / chos nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba'o/

/de dag la'ang ston pa chos kyi sku rdo rje gur bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa dang / khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ drug dang ni sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa drug yin la/ sbyong byed zhe sdang rnam par dag pa mi bskyod pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa drug go /lnga ni sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang / sbyong byed/ rtsa rgyud las/ gzungs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la ni dkar mor bshad/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /drug gnyis ni sbyang gzhi mig sogs skye mched bcu gnyis dang / sbyong byed/ nang gi skye mched drug la/ rtsa rgyud las/ mig la gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs dang / 'og nas/ gti mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyang / /zhes sogs so/ /phyi yi gzugs sogs skye mched drug ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gzugs la gau rir rtag tu bshad/ /sgra yi cha la chom rkun ma/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no/ /skye 'gro ni sems can rnams dang / bzhi po ni/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa dang / 'dus ma byas zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang bzhi'o/ /'o na/ zag pa med pa skye 'gror ji ltar 'gro zhe na/ sa dang po nas gnyis pa la sogs par rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'pho zhing 'gro bas skye 'gro'o/ /'di dag sbyong byed la sbyar na he ru ka bzhi yin no/ /yang na/ skye 'gro bzhi ni khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad/ drod gsher dang / sgo nga dang / mngal dang / rdzus te skye ba las byung bas na skye 'gro bzhi yin la/ de sbyong bar byed pa lha'i mngon par rtogs pa/ mngon byang lnga las bskyed pas drod gsher dang / mngal skyes sbyong la/ sa bon dang rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pas sgong skyes/

skad cig gis bskyed pas brdzus skyes sbyong zhing / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rdzogs pa gcig gi mngon rtogs kyis kyang skye gnas bzhi kar sbyong ba yin no/ /gcig gi nyi shur ma tshang ba ni/ chos can khams bco brgyad/ de'i chos nyid dang bcu dgu yin la/ 'di'i sbyong byed kyi lha ni gong du skye mched bcu gnyis kyi skabs su bstan pa de rnams so/ /de ltar na/ phung khams skye mched la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ khams gsum ma lus pa dang ni 'dod khams dang / gzugs khams dang / gzugs med khams so/ /'dod khams su pha dang bu tsha dang ma mo ni ma ste pha ma bu tsha sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod la/ gzugs khams na 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral nas phyi rol du gyur pas na phyi rol dang / gzugs med khams na gzugs phyi rol du gyur te rang gi rtogs pa'i ye shes/ nam mkha' mtha' yas dang / rnam shes mtha' yas dang / ci yang med pa dang / yod min med min gyi ye shes lta ba la brten pas nang ngo / /de dag gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ btsun mo kun dang ni 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i phyir 'dod khams so/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la longs spyod pas chos rnams ni gzugs kyi khams so/ /bdag med pa ni bdag med pa dang phyogs mthun pas gzugs med pa'i khams so/ /thams cad las ni khams gsum po de dag so so'i las so/ /de ltar khams gsum po de dag gi sbyong byed ni sku gsum gyi lha mo ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi lha mo'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /des na/ khams gsum gyi bsdus pa la yang snga ma bzhin du bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di lam dang 'bras bu la sbyar na/ spyir bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha mo dpag tu med pa gcig yod kyang / bsdu na/ lhan cig spyod ma dang / rjes su 'brang ma zhes bya ba gnyis yin la/ de la btsun mo ni spyan la sogs pa lhan cig spyod ma'o/

/chos ni gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rjes su 'brang ma'o/ /thams cad las ni spyan la sogs lhan cig spyod mas bde ba skyed pa'i las byed la/ rjes su 'brang mas mchod pa'i las byed do/ /bdag med ces pa ni/ thun mong gi lta ba dang / sgom pa'i ye shes kyi don yin no/ /de ltar na/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi la tshig dum bu sum cu so bdun du byas te/ gtso bor rgyu'i rgyud la sbyar nas ston pa chos kyi sku'i bzhugs tshul du bstan to/ /gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyud la bzhugs par bstan pa la lnga/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud gsum la 'jug cing 'phags pa nyan thos kyi lam 'bras la bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam 'bras la bzhugs pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa ba'i lam 'bras la bzhugs pa dang / dbu ma pas khas blangs pa'i lam 'bras la bzhugs pa dang / rdo rje theg pa bas khas blangs pa'i lam 'bras la bzhugs pa'o/ /dang po ni thog mar nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis lam dang 'bras bu ston pa'i gzhung 'di/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud gsum la sbyar na/ 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni/ 'og gi bsgrub bya ces pa dang sbyar te/ 'bras bu'i rgyud sangs rgyas kyi sa bstan pa ste/ bshad gzhi sku bzhi dang / 'chad byed yan lag lngas bsdus pa'o/ /rgyu dang zhes pas rgyu'i rgyud de/ 'og gi rdo rje zhes pa dang sbyar bas rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa/ rten gyi gang zag rgyu la ltos pa la sogs pa bzhi bstan/ bya ba zhes bya ba ni/ gang gi bya ba thabs kyi rgyud de/ 'og gi bsgrub thabs ces pa dang sbyar la/ gang zag rim 'jug la mngon par rtogs pa bco brgyad/ cig car 'jug pa la mngon par rtogs pa bco brgyad de/ thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa sum cu so drug bstan no/ /des na/ rgyud 'di'i brjod bya'i don mngon par rtogs pa rgyud gsum gyi rtsa ba ni tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di yin par shes par bya'o/

/da ni bsdus don dang sbyar te so so la sbyar ba las/ dang po nyan thos kyi lam 'bras la sbyar na/ 'bras bu zhes pas/ rgyun du zhugs pa zhugs gnas dang / lan gcig phyir 'ong ba zhugs gnas dang / phyir mi 'ong ba zhugs gnas dang / dgra bcom pa zhugs gnas te/ skyes bu zung bzhi dang / de dag re re la 'bras bu la zhugs pa dang / 'bras bu la gnas pa gnyis kyis phye bas gang zag ya brgyad ces bya ba bstan no/ /rgyu zhes bya ba ni/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi dad pa dang / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gang zag go /bya ba zhes bya ba ni lam ste/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pa/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshul khrims la gnas nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis sbyong ba ste/ bden pa bzhis bsdus pa yin no/ /de ltar nyan thos kyi bsdus pa la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ bsgrub bya ni rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu ste/ bse ru ltar gcig pur gnas pa dang / ne tso ltar khyur lding pa'am tshogs na spyod pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /sgrub thabs ni lam ste/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog tu sgom pa'o/ /rdo rje ni rgyu ste rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can gyi gang zag go /de ltar rang sangs rgyas kyi lam 'bras la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam pas khas blangs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu la zhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzhung gi dngos su bstan pa dang / shugs la rtogs par bya ba'i don gnyis su sbyar te/ de la/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang / /zhes bya ba ni/ dngos su rgyu kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa bstan te/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/

/de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos kun sa bon thams cad pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa kun gzhi ste/ /de bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ /dam pa dag la ngas bshad do/ /zhes gsungs la/ rtogs par bya ba gnas gyur gyi 'bras bu ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gang yin pa/ /de ni me long ye shes gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /chos zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu ma dag pa nyon mongs pa can gyi yid bdag tu rtog pa/ bdag tu rmongs pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba yin la/ dbyings zhes pa/ dha tu ni rgyu ste nyon mongs pa can de dag skye ba'i rgyu yin zhing / shugs la 'bras bu mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bstan te/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ nyon mongs can yid gnas gyur pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes gnas su 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /ma byung dang zhes pas/ dngos su bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes bstan la/ shugs la bya ba nan tan gyi rgyu sgo lnga'i rnam shes bstan te/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ dbang po lnga yi rnam shes gzhan/ /de ni don kun yongs su 'dzin/ /thob nas sems can kun don du/ /de ni bya ba grub pa tsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i khams kyis dngos su so sor rtog pa'i ye shes bstan la/ shugs la ye shes de'i rgyu yid kyi rnam shes bstan te/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /yid kyi rnam shes de nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ de yang nam mkha' ltar thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thugs su chud nas/ rang dbyings zhes pas/ skye ba med pa la skye ba'i cho 'phrul du byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la ye shes bzhi byung ba ste/ tsan+d+ra go mis/ de yang chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi/ /ngo bo nyid du yang dag 'dod/ /ces gsung pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rnal 'byor spyod pa bas khas blangs pa'i lam 'bras la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/

/bzhi pa ni/ dbu ma pas khas blangs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu la bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ bdag med pa dang zhes bya ba ni/ don dam par gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gis stong la/ kun rdzob tu snang ba mi 'gal bas bdag ces bya ba yin te/ mdo las/ dngos 'di spangs nas stong pa mi brtsal ste/ /snang dus nyid na stong pa nyid yin phyir/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par grol ba bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'o/ /de nyid gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ dngos po med dang zhes pas/ rigs pas brtags na rang bzhin med pa yin te/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas/ gang gis dngos po rnam dpyad na/ /de nyid du na de dngos med/ /gang gi phyir na de dag la/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin med/ /ces dang / dbu ma rgyan las/ bdag gzhan smra ba'i dngos 'di dag /yang dag du na gcig pa dang / /du ma'i rang bzhin bral ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin med de gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /zhes gsungs la/ kun rdzob tu snang ba mi 'gal bas dngos med min pa ste/ dbu ma bden gnyis chung ba las/ rgyu rkyen dag gis bskyed pas na/ /kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba grub/ /gal te grub tu mi rung na/ /chu zla la sogs su yis bskyed/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ snang ba dang ni stong pa gnyis/ /so so'i char ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug par bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba zung du 'jug pa yin no/ /de ltar dbu ma pas lam 'bras la yang ston pa chos kyi sku bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ rdo rje theg pas khas blangs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu la bzhugs pa las/ thog mar bskyed rim la sbyar na/ tshogs gnyis gsag pa sngon du song nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas bsgom pa ni gru gsum mo/ /de'i nang du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni bde ba can no/

/der mngon par byang chub pa rim pa lnga las/ a skyes ni ā li las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du kā li las skyon bral te mun pa'i skyon dang bral bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i bar du sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa ni rnam par rtog pa'i rdul dang bral bas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pa spros nas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bcom nas don byas tshur 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las lha'i skur bzhengs nas rnam par rtog pa'i rba rlabs med pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /de yang / rtsa rgyud las/ ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ /sa bon nang du song gyur pa/ /de nyid sems dpa' zhes byar brjod/ /ces dang / zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /so sor rtog par brjod par bya/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yis/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas ye shes pa gzhug pa la sog pa yan lag drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar bskyed pa snang la rang bzhin med pa spros bral du bsgom pa ni zhi ba'i bde rig ste/ 'og nas/ nga yi sku ni bsgom byed na/ /gal te sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i tshig de dag rdzogs rim rang byin rlabs la sbyar na/ bde ba can ni lte ba/ gru gsum ni dbyibs/ de la brten nas rang byung gi ye shes skyes pa'i dus su skye ba med par go ba ni a skyes/ de la nyon mongs pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ rtog pa'i rdul med pa/ spang bya'i sdig pa bcom pa/ mtshan rtog gi rba rlabs med pa/

spang bya'i tshogs thams cad zhi ba/ thob bya'i bde ba thams cad rig pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /dbang chos la sbyar na/ bde ba can ni yum gyi mkha' mchog gi ze ba/ gru gsum ni dbyibs/ a skyes ni dga' ba'i ye shes/ skyon bral ni mchog dga'/ rdul bral ni dga' bral/ sdig bcom ni lhan skyes/ rba rlabs med pa ni lhan skyes la rnam rtog gi rba rlabs med pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi zhing / bde ba chen po'i ye shes rig pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa gsum la tshigs dum bu nyi shu rtsa gsum du byas nas/ gtso bor thabs kyi rgyud la sbyar te ston pa chos kyi sku mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur bzhugs zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i rgyud la bzhugs par bstan pa ni/ gsang ba ni/ sa dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam snang ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthar phyin pa/ mchog ni chu rnam par dag pa ma mā kī dang / mi bskyod pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar phyin pa/ dgyes pa ni me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dang / snang ba mtha' yas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar phyin pa/ thams cad bdag nyid dang / yang rtag tu bzhugs pa ni dus yin mod kyi/ re zhig 'bras bu la sbyar na/ rlung dang nam mkha' rnam par dag pa sgrol ma dang / rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam pa nyid/ don yod grub pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang sbyin pa dang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar phyin pa rnams bstan pa yin no/ /de skad du/ saṃ bu ṭi'i brtag pa drug pa dngos las/ gsang ba la ni sa yi khams/ /mchog la de bzhin du ni chu/ /dgyes pa la ni me ru bshad/ /thams cad bdag nyid rlung du gnas/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa bdag

/yang na me long lta bu'i tshul/ /shin tu rnam dag rang bzhin can/ /so sor rtog pa rang bzhin can/ /de bzhin du yang mnyam pa nyid/ /de bzhin bya ba nan tan la/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /mi bskyod pa yi ngo bo dang / /yang na 'od dpag med pa yis/ /yang na rin chen 'byung gnas la/ /gang tshe rtag bzhugs don yod do/ /zhes gsung pa yin no/ /des na/ gsang ba nas bdag nyid kyi bar la tshig dum bu bzhir byas nas/ 'bras bu'i rgyud la yang ston pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes bsgrub bya'i rigs pa chos kyi sku chen po de thams cad du snang zhing thams cad du khyab pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rtag tu bzhugs zhes pa ste/ chos kyi sku ni chos nyid rgyun gyis rtag pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni 'og min las gnas 'pho ba med pa'i tshul gyis rtag cing / sprul pa'i sku ni mdzad pa phrin las kyis sems can gyi don rtag tu mdzad cing bzhugs pa ste/ saṃ ṭir/ rtag pa brtan pa mchog tu yang / /yid bsrub so sor gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di/ rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i tshig gi don bsdus nas bstan te/ gsang ba ni chos phun sum tshogs pa ste/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de ni 'di skad ces bya ba'i don yin no/ /mchog ni sdud pa po mchog tu gyur pa sa bcu pa'am/ ston pa nyid kyi ye shes te 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bdag gis zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /dgyes pa ni chos thos pas rtogs shing khong du chud nas dgyes pa ste/ thos pa zhes bya ba sdud pa po'i yon tan yin no/ /rtag tu zhes bya ba sku gsum gyi mdzad pa ste/ dus phun sum tshogs pa dus gcig na zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /thams cad bdag nyid ces bya ba ni/ thams cad kyi bdag po'am yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba yin no/ /bzhugs zhes bya ba ni/ ston pa sku gsum gyi bzhugs gnas zhing khams so sor rnam par dag pa ste/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i don te/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig rkang pa gnyis po 'di 'brel pa can du yod pa dang / 'grel pas spang po byas pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa rtsa ba drug pa yin pa dang / rgya dper yang / ra ha s+ya/ pa ra me/ ra me/ sarbā/ rta na/ sa ta/ s+d+yi ta/ zhes yi ge bcu drug po 'di phyogs gcig na yod pa bzhin bzhag go /gsum pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs shing / shes bya la blo rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa de nyid rigs lnga po kun la khyab cing / sems can gyi don la nus pa dang ldan pas sems dpa' ni rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs gzhan sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha' ltar yangs pa nam mkha' la sprul nas ji ltar 'dod pa nam mkha' la longs spyod cing 'gro bas mkha' 'gro ma longs spyod rdzogs pa/ rdo rje ni shes rab/ gur ni thabs te thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i sku drug pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'o/ /de'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'di ni chos kyi sku rang byung spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pas bcom ldan 'das/ de'i sprul pa'i sku ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad kyi bdag po yin la/ 'gran zla dang thams cad bral bas gcig pu nyid do/ /bzhi pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don no/ /dang po ni/ sngon ston pas rgyud rgyas pa gsungs pa'i tshe/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor mdzad nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor til gyi gang bu dang mnyam pa dang / rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa dang / dpa' bo'i 'khor bye ba phrag brgyad cu rnams ni sprul pa yin la/ rang rgyud pa'ang yod par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rang rgyud pa'i 'khor 'gro ba rgyud yongs su dag pa byang chub sems dpa' lha dang mis gtso byas pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs so/ /de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor rnams ni rigs lngar bsdus/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor rnams ni ngo bo ye shes dang tshad kyi phye na brgyad du bsdus te bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du dkyil 'khor lngar gnas la/ 'khor gzhan rnams lha snam la gnas so/ /'o na dkyil 'khor lngar grangs nges pa gsungs pa ci zhe na/ sngon byung rgyud rgyas pa gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di bzhin du sprul la/ ma 'ongs pa bsgom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la'ang / rigs rkyang pa dang bsdus pa gang bsgom yang 'di bzhin du bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ lha dang mi dang byams pa la sogs pa'i 'khor rgyas par ma gsungs par/ 'khor grangs nges gsungs pa'i dgos pa de yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor dang / lha mo'i 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ sngon byung rgyud rgyas pa gzhung tshad sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga'i bdag nyid du ston pa kye rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyis/ gdul bya 'khor rnams la ston pa'i tshe/ de'i las ni sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lngar sprul nas gsungs pa de nyid/ ma 'ongs pa na gdul bya rjes 'jug rnams mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa la yang dkyil 'khor lngar gsungs la/ lnga gang zhe na/ rdo rje can mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / phan pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor dang / de bzhin rdo rje gzi brjid rin 'byung gi dkyil 'khor dang / pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor dang /

rta bdun rgyal po don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ste lnga'o/ /'di dag gi zhal phyag sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs 'og nas ston no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ lha mo'i grangs dang / de rnams spyi'i rnam pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la lnga'i/ dang po rdo rje can gyi 'khor ni/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi 'khor gang zhe na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du/ shar du dkar mo/ lhor chom rkun ma/ nub tu ro langs ma/ byang du ghasma ri dang / byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo'o/ /'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan le'u bzhi par 'chad do/ /gnyis pa rtag pa'i 'khor ni/ rdo rje phan pa rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor du/ shar du skam pa nag mo/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo nyid dang / nub tu dol zlum ma dmar mo dang / byang du lcags kyu ma ljang khu dang / byang shar du me tog ma dkar mo dang / la sogs pas/ shar lhor bdug spos ma dud kha dang / lho nub tu mar me ma ser mo dang / nub byang du dri chab ma dmar mo rnams mtshams kyi char ro/ /gsum pa rdo rje nyi ma'i 'khor ni/ rdo rje nyi ma rin 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du/ shar du nyi lag ma dkar mo dang / lhor mar me ma dmar mo dang / nub tu rin chen sgron ma ser mo dang / byang du klog lag ma ljang khu dang / byang shar du la s+ye ma dkar mo dang / la sogs pas/ shar lhor glu ma ser mo dang / bden bral du gar ma ljang khu dang / rlung du bzhad ma dmar mo rnams mtshams char ro/ /bzhi pa pad+ma gar dbang gi 'khor ni/ gar gyi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du/ shar du pad+ma mo dkar mo dang / gshin rjer chos 'byung ma ser mo dang / chu bdag tu lcags sgrog ma dmar mo dang / gnod sbyin du 'khyud ma ljang khu dang / dbang ldan du gling bu ma ser mo dang / sogs kyis/ mer pi waṃ ma dkar mo dang /

srin por rdza rnga ma dkar mo dang / rlung du rnga zlum ma ljang khu rnams mtshams kyi char dgod do/ /dkyil 'khor bar ma gsum gyi mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang cha lugs ni lha mo rang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i bdag nyid kyi cha byad sbyor ba'i phyag rgya bya bas gnas so/ /lnga pa don grub kyi 'khor ni/ rta'i rgyal po don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar du rdo rje sgo lcags ma dkar mo dang / lhor lde kyog ma ser mo dang / nub tu sgo ma dmar mo dang / byang du gos 'dzin ma ljang khu dang / de bzhin byang shar mtshams su spyan ma dkar mo dang / sogs kyis shar lhor ma mā ki sngon mo/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo dkar mo/ nub byang du sgrol ma ljang khu rnams so/ /rnam snang sogs dkyil 'khor bzhi'i phyogs kyi lha mo'i phyag mtshan rnams/ 'og le'u bzhir ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i phyogs mtshams la bkod pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro de rnams kun/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ skra brdzes ma/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ rkang pa g.yas bskum zhing / rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang bas gnas pa/ khyad par can gyi lha mo rnams ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing / g.yon khu tshur bcangs nas snying khar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa ste/ thams cad phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pas kha dog sna tshogs pa/ sku las 'od zer cher 'bar ba'o/ /lnga pa 'khor gyi phrin las chos phun sum tshogs pa la gsum/ phrin las kyi sgo nas don ji ltar mdzad pa dngos dang / don mdzad pa'i 'thad pa dang / phrin las la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ phrin las rgyas par bstan pa dang / bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ lha mo rnams kyi phrin las dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phrin las so/ /dang po ni/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa shin tu zhe sdang can gyi skye bo rnams 'dul ba'i don du zhe sdang rnam par dag pa lha mo gau ri la sogs pa zhe sdang chen po'i skur sprul nas de dag gi zhe sdang zhi bar mdzad par grags pa de bzhin du/

rjes 'jug sems can rnams la'ang de dang mthun par sku'i sprul pa bstan nas byang chub la 'god par mdzad pa ste/ mnyam sbyor rgyas pa las/ zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang rdo rje de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sbyar la/ tshangs pa la sogs pa shin tu gti mug rmongs chen pas/ gti mug dag pa lha mo skam pa ma la sogs pa cher bzung te de dag 'dul ba'o/ /brgya sbyin la sogs pa shin tu nga rgyal gyis gzi brjid can rnams la/ nga rgyal dag pa cher gsal ba lha mo nyi lag ma la sogs pa sprul nas btul bar rab tu grags/ dbang phyug la sogs pa shin tu 'dod chags che ba'i gdul bya rnams la/ 'dod chags chen po dag pa las/ lha mo pad+ma la sogs pa sprul nas rdo rje chos kyi dkyil 'khor du bkod nas 'dod chags can byang chub la 'god par mdzad la/ dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs pa phrag dog chen po'i gdul bya la/ phrag dog chen po'i sgrib pa chen po las dag la lha mo sgo lcags ma la sogs pa sprul nas myur 'gro'i bdag po don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du bkod de phrag dog can rnams btul nas byang chub la 'god par mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las la gnyis/ gsung gis don mdzad pa dang / skus don mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba mgon po phan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes brnyes pas ni/ gdul bya'i gti mug thams cad las rgyu 'bras kyi chos gsungs nas zad par mdzad/ rdo rje nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyal po chen pos/ gdul bya'i rnam par rtog pa bdag tu lta ba'i rab rib 'phrog pa'i chos gsung ba dang / rta mgrin so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'dod pa chen po ni rtog pa las dbugs 'byin pa/ 'dod chags bsten pa'i sgo nas 'dod chags can gyi byang chub ster/ rdo rje mgyogs 'gro bya ba grub pa'i ye shes phrag dog chen pos/

gdul bya rnams nyan thos la sogs pa'i theg pa gzhan gyi lam ni rnam par spangs nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad la/ ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che rtog pas mi g.yo bas mi bskyod chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de las 'byung ba'i gnas/ shes rab snying rjes skye 'gro rnams nyon mongs pa mi zad pa bri ba med pa las 'don pa'i thabs ston pas mgron gnyer phyir/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa lnga ni ye shes lnga'i ngo bor 'joms pa po ste gang la ci 'dul gyi sgo nas chos gsungs pas sems can 'dul bar mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga pos ye shes lnga'i ngo bor nyon mongs pa lnga rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i gsung gi phrin las mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang can dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / 'dod chags can dang / ser sna dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams 'dul zhing rang gi 'khor du bsdu ba'i phyir/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang rang gi gdul bya'i 'khor rnams la/ 'dul byed mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i gzugs sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dbu'i grangs dang phyag gi grangs la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam 'phrul du ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar/ saṃ ṭir/ gang dang gang gis gnas gyur pa/ /de ni de yi ngo bo can/ /bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs pas ni/ /dgyes pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la lnga'i/ dang po zhe sdang can 'dul ba ni/ gdul bya shin tu gdug pa drag po'i zhe sdang dang ldan pa la 'dul ba'i thabs zhi ba nye bar mi sbyor te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ zhe sdang can de zhi bas mi 'dul ba 'di mkhyen nas/ de 'dul ba'i thabs la rigs drug pa rdo rje can chen pos ni rang nyid mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje khro chags kyi skur gyur nas 'dul ba'o/ /gnyis pa gti mug can 'dul ba ni/

gdul bya gti mug can bag chags dang bcas pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas shin tu non nas/ skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod pa'i stong pa skur 'debs la zhen pa rnams dang / las rgyu 'bras yod pa ma yin par 'dod pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin cing / sdig pa sna tshogs byed pa rnams kyi don du/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gti mug dag pa'i spyod pas rdo rje 'dzin pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur gyur pas 'dul ba'o/ /gsum pa nga rgyal can 'dul ba ni/ gdul bya shin tu ser sna dang nga rgyal can gyi gdug rnams kyi skye 'gro'i ser sna dang nga rgyal zad par mdzad pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid rdo rje nyi ma rin 'byung gi bdag nyid rgyal bar sprul nas/ gdul bya nga rgyal dang ser sna chen po'i mun pa 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'dod chags can 'dul ba ni/ gdul bya yul la zhen pa'i 'dod chags can rnams la/ byang chub chags pa dang bral ba las skyes pa spangs pas spong ba lam du byed pa dang / sems can gang zhig rgyud 'dod chags kyis bde bar byed pa bsten pas lam du byed pa la/ chags pas byang chub rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi skur gyur nas 'dul ba'o/ /lnga pa phrag dog can 'dul ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa la gnas par rgyu yod bzhin du/ phrag dog can gyi gdul bya gang zhig mu stegs dang nyan thos la sogs pa'i lam gzhan nas 'gro ba de rnams la/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rab tu sbyin par bya ba'i phyir/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid 'dul byed brtson 'grus kyi rang bzhin rdo rje mgyogs 'gro don yod grub par gyur nas 'dul bar mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus te bstan pa la gnyis/ skus don mdzad pa dang / gsung gis don mdzad pa'o/

/dang po ni/ yul can dbang po gang dang yul gang lam nyid yul can de dang yul de'i ngo bor gang 'dul gyi 'gro la/ mchog tu mngon par shes pas gzigs nas gdul bya de dang de la phan pa lhun gyis grub par 'jug cing / thabs dang shes rab kyi rnal 'byor gyis sangs rgyas rigs lnga po kun gyi bdag nyid drug pa rdo rje 'dzin pas 'dul bar 'gyur la/ gdul bya las gang dang gang gis nyon mongs lnga'i dngos po'i rigs su skyes pa rnams ni yid 'dun pa'i thabs kyi sbyor ba des ni gang la ci 'dul de'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur te/ dper na/ ras kha dog sna tshogs pa'i steng du nor bu chu shel bzhag pas ras kyi mdog dang gzugs su 'gyur ba ji bzhin du gang 'dul gyi skur ston pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dul byed kyi thabs gang dang gang gis 'dul ba'i gdul bya sems can 'dul bar gyur pa ste/ gang la ci 'dul de dang de la de'i blo'i rnam pa dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor gyi chos kyi gtam bshad pa'i sgo nas gdul bar bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa don mdzad pa'i 'thad pa ni/ de ltar rnam 'phrul du mas sems can gyi don mdzad kyang / sems can rnams thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis kun tu bslad pas 'dul bar mi nus so snyam na/ de ltar yin mod/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje ste spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin nyid las byung ba yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing gos pa med/ /ces dang / mtshan brjod las/ rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas las byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thog ma mtha' ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ces dang / lang dkar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dge /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/de ltar sems nyid rang bzhin gyi dri ma med pa'i spros bral yin na/ chos can sna tshogs su snang ba 'di ci las byung snyam na/ de ni sems can bsam pa sna tshogs pa nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin can gyi sems ni rang gi bdag tu 'dzin pa la sogs pa glo bur gyi rnam rtog gis skye bo de dag nyon mongs pa'i dri mas glo bur du nag por byas pa yin gyis/ gdod ma nas dri ma yod pa ma yin pas sbyang du rung ste/ dper na gser g.ya' dang bcas pa sbyang du btub pa bzhin no/ /de bas na glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i thabs lam la dus kun tu rab tu 'bad pas sems kyi rdo rje stong pa las glo bur du byung ba'i dri ma rnam par sbyangs pas dag par 'gyur te/ dper na chu rnyog ma dang bcas pa'i gseb tu nor bu chu dwangs bzhag pas skad cig la rnyog ma dwangs 'gro ba bzhin du lam gyi sbyang du rung ba yin la/ de ltar sbyangs pa las sems kyi glo bur gyi dri ma'i nyon mongs pa logs su bsgyur du med de/ sprin dengs nas nam mkha'i chos nyid du gyur pa bzhin nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes kyi chos nyid du dag pa ni zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po yin la/ glo bur gyi dri ma'i nyon mongs pa'i dug ni thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du 'phrog pa ste gnas gyur pa'o/ /de yang / dbus mtha' las/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par gnas/ /zhes dang / slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos/ rnam par rtog las ma gtogs pa/ /'khor ba zhes bya ci yang med/ /rnam rtog de dang bral bas na/ /khyod ni rtag tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ar+ya dā+e was/ de bzhin rin chen sems 'di yang / /rtog pa'i tshon gyis bsgyur ba nyid/ /tha mal rtog pa'i tshon gyis ni/ /rin chen sems 'di dben gyur na/ /thog ma nas dag ma skyes pa/ /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin dri ma med/ /ces gsungs so/

/gsum pa phrin las la rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis/ rgol ba dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ 'o na sems la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dri mas gos pa de sbyong ba la thabs gang gis sbyong snyam na/ 'dir kha cig na re/ gal te bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ lha'i sku mdog la sogs pas ci zhig bya ste/ des bdag 'dzin bzlog mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na stong pa nyid kyi lta ba kho na thabs mchog tu yin te/ bdag med nyid bdag 'dzin dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro snyam du rtog pa'o/ /gnyis pa lan la bzhi/ stong pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas mi thob pa dang / stong pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang / thabs kyi rnam pas don mdzad pa'i 'thad pa dang / don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ stong nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub par 'dod pa yin pa de'i tshe bskal pa bye bas kyang sangs rgyas gzugs sku nyid thob par mi 'gyur te/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi ting nge 'dzin bzhin no/ /des na rgyu 'dra ba las 'bras bu 'dra ba bsgrubs pa yin te/ de skad du/ ko ṭa pa las/ gang du yang / /sa lu'i sa bon gang du mthong / /zhes bshad de/ ko ṭa pa las sa lu mi skye ba bzhin no/ /de ltar rgyu bskyed rim bsgom pa las 'bras bu gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba las thabs gzhan stong nyid bsgom pas 'grub pa min pa de'i phyir/ gzugs sku 'grub pa'i thabs ni stong pa nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom pa ma yin no/ /de la/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni/ chos kyi sku la zer gyi/ gzugs kyi rnam pa bsgom pa ci dgos/ mdo las/ gang gis nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang gis nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log par shes pa'i bsam pa can/ /skye bo de yis nga mi mthong / /zhes gsungs so zhe na/ de ni chos nyid 'ba' zhig la dgongs pa ste/ gzugs kyi sku thob par 'dod na mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku nyid bsgom dgos te/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang mdor bsdu na/

/ting 'dzin ye shes las nges byung / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ma rtogs par/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor pas mi thob/ /ces dang / slob dpon 'dul ba byin gyis/ gzugs sku chos kyi sku yin sgom byed pa/ /ka ye nges par byang chub thob pa yin/ /chos sku rgyal ba'i bsam gtan gyis thob na/ /gzugs sku bsod nams tshogs kyis thob na yang / /de ni yun ring dus gzhan dman pa ste/ /'bras bu'i khyad par rgyu yi khyad par las/ /sku gsum dus mnyam par ni snang ba yin/ /zhes dang / grub chen shī dha ras/ sangs rgyas nyid ni sgrub pa'i rgyu/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor kun tu yang / /rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu nyid/ /kun tu mthong ba ma yin nam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na rgyal ba'i yum la sogs par/ stong nyid bsgom par gsungs pa de'i dgos pa gang yin snyam na/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba chos bdag med pa la sogs pa rnams las log cing mi mthun pa rnams dang / mu stegs pa'i rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag tu lta ba 'dzin cing 'tshol ba rnams kyis rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag dang / gang zag gi bdag dang / chos kyis bdag rnams la bdag tu zhen cing 'dzin pa'i bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir dang / chos sku 'grub pa'i thabs su stong pa nyid rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa yin la/ stong pa nyid la'ang zhen pas mchog tu 'dzin du mi rung ba yin no/ /de ltar du/ mdo las/ lta ba'i 'thibs por gnas par gyur pa las/ /'byung ba'i mchog ni stong pa nyid yin na/ /gang zhig stong pa kho nar lta gyur pa/ /de ni gsor mi rung zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ phung 'di stong zhes rtogs na byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu grub kyis/ rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa nyid/ /lta kun nges par 'byin par gsungs/ /gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba/

/de kun bsgrub tu med par gsungs/ /zhes dang / gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas/ /lta ba thams cad spang ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa'i/ /go tam de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa las/ kun rtog thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi ston mdzad na/ /gang zhig de la zhen gyur pa/ /de nyid khyod kyis shin tu smad/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyu 'dra ba las 'bras bu 'dra ba bsgrub dgos pa/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni bskyed rim mo zhes gzugs sku 'grub pa'i thabs ni bsten pas lam du byed pa dka' ba'i spyod pa ma yin pa bde ba'i lam dang tha mal gyi rnam rtog sdom pa ste spong ba la sangs rgyas nga rgyal bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gyis sangs rgyas gzugs sku nyid du tshe 'di la myur du 'grub par 'gyur la/ de yang gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar ston pa mi chen po'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / gtso bo dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang ldan par lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos so/ /de dag gis gang dag bskyed rim gyis mchog gi dngos grub mi thob par 'dod pa'i log rtog rnams bsal ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bskyed rim gyis gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa de phyir thabs lha'i rnal 'byor gyi nga rgyal gyis bsgrub par bya ba dang / bskyed rim de ni gzugs kyi sku bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi gzugs can khyad par 'phags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa le'u'i ming ni/ rigs lnga po thams cad kyi lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam pas tha mal gyi rtog pa mchog tu zhi ba ste sbyang ba'i sgo nas sems can rnams rigs lnga'i dngos grub la 'jug pa ston pa'i le'u ste rgyud 'di la le'u bco lnga yod pa'i dang po yin pas dang po sh+lau ka sum cu so bdun dang rkang pa gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa'o//

༈ //spyi don gnyis pa gang bshad pa'i chos phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ le'u gnyis pa nas le'u bco lnga pa'i bar gyis le'u bcu bzhis gsal bar 'chad par byed do/ /de la yang gzhung rab tu 'khrugs pas na le'u so so'i sdom las spyi'i sdom ni mi btub bo/ /de la thog mar le'u gnyis pa 'chad pa la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don no/ /dang po ni/ brjod bya spyi dang sbas pa/ rjod byed yan lag gi don gyis 'chad/ mngon par rtogs pa smin byed dbang dang / grol byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis char 'jug drod dang las tshogs kyang cung zad 'jug la/ 'bum lnga'i tshad ni rjod byed yin pas thams cad thun mong ba yin no/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi gang du phan 'dogs na/ mchod pa dang spyod lam ni le'u gsum pa/ brgyad pa/ phyi ma'i lnga par kha bskang zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang rdul tshon ni bcu par kha bskang la/ 'byung po 'dul ba dang stobs po che ni le'u gnyis par kha bskang / rdzogs rim ni le'u dang po dang / brgyad pa/ lnga pa rnams su mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar byed la/ stobs kyis bsgrub pa ni le'u drug pa dang phyi ma'i gnyis par kha bskang zhing / sangs rgyas kyis gar gyi char dbab la sogs pa las tshogs su byed na le'u gnyis par kha bskang la/ bskyed rim brtan par bya ba'i yan lag la tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed na brtag pa gong 'og gi le'u bdun pa gnyis su gsal bar byed la/ sa bzung ba'i skabs su byed na le'u bcu par kha bskang ngo / /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ don dngos dang / le'u'i ming ngo / /dang po la lnga ste/ mchod pa la sogs pa rigs lngas phye ste bstan pa dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang / sangs rgyas kyi de kho na nyid dang / rgyud 'bum phrag lnga yi grangs dang / sangs rgyas kyi gar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/

mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang / spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / rdul tshon bstan pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu dri yi mchod pa dang / ro'i mchod pa dang / me tog gi mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ le'u dang po brjod bya rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i rjes de nas drug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa khams gsum ste sku gsum thob cing brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i rdo rje gur thabs shes rab kyi bdag nyid can gyi ston pa des rigs so so'i phye bas rang rang gi rigs las mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig gi mchod pa yid du 'ong ba rigs lnga la mchod pa'i don du rang gi 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa dang rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo dang rgyud yongs su dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la rab tu bka' bstsal pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mchod pa dngos dang / mchod pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ glu ni sgra rnam par dag pa rdo rje can mi bskyod pa la dbul zhing / gar ni gzugs rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la dbul/ dri rnam par dag pa hi ra mchog nor bu'i ming ste rin chen 'byung ldan la de bzhin dri'i mchod pa dbul/ ro rnam par dag pa'i 'jig rten rje 'od dpag med la bza' ba dang btung ba dbul/ kha dog lngar phye ba'i gos kyi mchod pa ni reg bya rnam par dag pa rta mchog don yod grub pa la dbul ste rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs dang mthun pa'i mchod pa 'di rnams mchod pa las mi 'da' bas dam tshig dam pa ste tha mal gyi rtog pa med pa'i rdo rje'i rdzas kyi mchod pa byas pa yis dbul ba'i yul rdo rje can rigs lnga po kun mnyes nas dngos grub ster bar byed do/ /gsum pa dri'i mchod pa la gnyis/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang / mchod pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ dri'i bye brag a ka ru nag po ni mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje la dbul/

phan pa rnam snang la ni tsan+dan dkar po dbul/ tsan+dan dmar po ni 'jig rten rje 'od dpag med la dbul/ kha che gur kum rdo rje snang ba rin 'byung la dbul/ bdun gyi rgyal po don yod grub pa ni phrin las thams cad byed pas kha dog gis phye ba'i dri thams cad dbul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong gi dri de rnams dbul ba'i tshe hūm̐ las bskyed de tha mal gyi dri mi dmigs par byas pa'i rdo rje las byung ba'i dri kha dog gi sgo nas phye ba 'di rnams dri'i mchod pa rab tu sbyor ba dbul bas dam pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i dngos grub nyid thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ro'i mchod pa'i bye brag tshwa ba dang kha ba'i ro dang ldan pa dri chu ni mi bskyod rdo rje la dbul/ mngar ba'i ro dang ldan pa dri chen ni rdo rje rtag pa rnam snang la dbul/ skyur ba'i ro dang ldan pa rak+ta ni rdo rje nyi ma rin chen 'byung ldan la dbul/ de bzhin du lan tshwa'i ro dang ldan pa byang chub kyi sems ni 'jig rten rje 'od dpag med la dbul/ rta'i rgyal po don grub la ro thams cad dam/ yang na bska ba'i ro dang ldan pa sha chen rtag par dbul bar bya ste/ de rnams bdud rtsi lnga'i phye nas rigs so so la dbul lo/ /de dag gi shugs la glu'ang rang gi bstod pas phye ba dang / gos kyang kha dog gis phye nas rigs so so la dbul ba shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gzugs kyi mchod pa'i bye brag kyai rdo rje rdo rje can mi bskyod pa la me tog mdog nag rkang pa'i chu 'thung ba las byung ba dbul/ me tog dkar po ma lā ka dang ma la ti dang / kun+da rnams dus rtag tu sangs rgyas rnam snang la 'bul/ shing gi dbang po ut+pal ser po dri ma med pa'i mdog bzang po mchog ni snang byed rin 'byung la ni sbyar bar bya/ dbang mchog ut+pal dmar po dang / chu skyes pad+ma dmar po dang / me tog bhan du dmar po dang /

pa ta laṃ dmar po rnams ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'od dpag med la dbul/ rta mchog rdo rje can don grub la ni me tog kha dog sna tshogs kun dbul bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru gsum pa ste de ni mi bskyod pa thugs yin pa'i phyir ye shes zhu bde mi rtog pa gsum mtshon pa dang / sangs rgyas la ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru bzhi pa yin la/ de ni rnam snang sku yin pas lus 'dom gang gru bzhi mtshon pa dang / snang byed la ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru lnga pa nyid de rin chen 'byung ldan yon tan yin te bdud rtsi lnga'i yon tan las byung ba mtshon pa dang / gar dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni khru drug pa ste 'od dpag med ni bde ba yin pas bdud rtsi lnga bde ba dang drug mtshon pa dang / rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshad de bzhin khru ni bdun te don grub phrin las yin pas bdud rtsi lnga dga' bral dang lhan skyes te bdun mtshon pas dkyil 'khor gyi tshad 'di dag ni nang don la dgongs pa yin no/ /gsum pa spyod lam ni/ kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe ro 'od dpag med la dbul yang ro'i yon tan lus rgyas par byed pa yin pas kha zas bza' ba'i dus rdo rje nyi ma'i nga rgyal gyi bza' la/ lam du 'gro ba phrin las yin pa'i phyir lugs kyi mchog don grub kyi nga rgyal gyis bya ba dang / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi gnyid ni gti mug yin pas sangs rgyas mgon po'i nga rgyal gyis bya ba dang / shin tu rjes su chags pa'i bde ba'i rnal 'byor la ni gar dbang gi nga rgyal gyis bya ba dang / le'u bcu bzhi pa nas 'byung ba'i glu dang gar dang de bzhin du rol mo'i sgra'i mchod pa byed pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi yongs su bzung ba'i dus rnams su ni bya ba thams cad he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis byed pas mi bskyod rdo rje'i gzugs su bzhag nas ni rnal 'byor pa bdag gi spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis bya ba thams cad rab tu sgrub par byed pa'o/

/bzhi pa rdul tshon ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdul tshon dam pa'i tshon dang ni/ /yang na 'bring po nyid kyi ste/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ rin chen lnga gang yin gsal bar 'chad pa yin te/ de yang / tshon gyi kha dog dang rgyu ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i la dbang po sngon po ni bod skad yin la/ rgya skad in+d+ra ni la ste/ zla ba chu shel dkar po ni thub chen rnam snang gi rigs kyi dang / mkhar phyin skyes pa'i me tog dmar/ /zhes pa la/ 'gyur gzhan du/ nor bu dmar rgyal mkha' mdzod kyi/ /zhes pa 'byung ste/ nor bu dmar rgyal dmar ser ni mkha' mdzod rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dang / pad+ma ra ga dmar po spyan ras gzigs 'od dpag med kyi dang / rta'i don yod grub pa la'ang ma ra ka ta margad ljang khu ste rigs kyi sgo nas kha dog gis phye ba'i rin chen lnga'i rdul tshon ni rdul tshon mchog yin la/ 'bring dang tha ma ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yang na 'bras la sogs pas so/ /dur khrod kyi ni so phag gam/ /de bzhin dur khrod sol ba yis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rin chen lnga'i rdul tshon de yang kha dog gi sgo nas rigs lnga'i rdul tshon du bstan pa yin gyi rigs lnga po la rdul tshon re res chog pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ 'og nas/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /rdul tshon gyis kyang bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa las rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ 'byung po 'dul ba'i rnal 'byor dang / stobs po che'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / lha'i rnal 'byor dngos dang / rnal 'byor gyi dgos pa dang / sngags bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa la sogs pa rigs lngar phye ste bshad pa'i rjes de nas bdud bzhi bcom zhing dbang phyug drug gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur 'byung po'i bgegs 'dul ba'i rnal 'byor gsung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mngon du snyoms par zhugs so/

/gnyis pa ni/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs nas me tog la sogs pas mchod pa dang / yan lag bdun dang / tshad med bzhi dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gsag dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa rnams ni le'u bcu gnyis pa nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ srung 'khor gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng du bgegs bsrung ba las mi 'da' bas dam tshig 'byung po 'dul ba'i rnal 'byor yang dag rab tu phye ba ni pad nyi'i steng du kun tu bzang po'i sa bon hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das 'byung po 'dul ba'i bdag po sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa 'byung po rnams 'dul bas 'jigs byed chen po ste/ mdzes zhing sgeg pa'i khro bo yi ni sku lus can/ 'byung po'i gtso bo dbang ldan gyi 'byung po zil gyis gnan pa ste/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas par rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje rtse lnga pa la/ phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub kyis bgegs sdigs par mdzad pa ste/ phyag lhag ma gnyis po dag gis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya snying khar sbyor zhing / zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yang dag gnas/ mche ba cung zad gtsegs pas bgegs 'jigs par byed pa/ mi'i mgo bo'i phreng ba lnga bcu'i rgyan mchog ste/ mgo 'dzings ni dbu skra phyed du bcing par ni/ ri rab kyi rtse mor bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ram ma bskur kyang rung ste rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab la/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ bkod pa la sngags kyis bskor la bzlas brjod bya zhing bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pas 'byung po 'dul ba'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur te/ dngos su ni gnod sbyin du ma dang / 'byung po du ma dang / gnod byin mo du ma dang /

klu mo dang / mi'i bu mo dang / lha'i bu mo mdzes ma du ma ni sgrub pa po yis gang 'dod pa de rnams dbang du 'du bar nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ dbang du bya ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra bhu ta a dhi pa ti ak+ṣo bh+ya ki rī ṭi na/ sarba bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa ni swa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi bya'o/ /gnyis pa stobs po che la lnga/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / lha'i rnal 'byor dang / sngags bstan pa dang / zhal gyi kha dog dang rgyan/ rnal 'byor gyi dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'byung po 'dul ba'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'i rjes de nas drug pa rdo rje can chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur stobs po che'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas char dbab pa'i cho ga gsung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ stobs po che'i rnal 'byor gyis char chen rab tu dbab par bya ste/ de yang tshogs gnyis gsag pa sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam pa'i steng der ni klu brgyad dgod par bya ste/ shar du mtha' yas nag po/ lhor nor rgyas dkar po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du stobs kyi rgyu sngon po/ me dang bden bral du pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po gnyis po gnyis ser skya/ rlung du dung skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan sna tshogs te/ de rnams stod mi la snying khar thal mo sbyar la/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dgu'am bdun dang ldan pa/ mjug ma rnams pad+ma'i lte bar 'khyil ba'i steng du/ 'og nas/ mkha' lding rdo rje gdan mdzad pa/ /zhes pas/ hūm̐ las nam mkha' lding mig sman gyi mdog lta bu mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ klu brgyad po de rnams kyi rnga ma bya khyung gi yang dag mnan cing / mkha' lding gi steng du stobs po che bsgom pa'i rab tu sbyor bas bya khyung bskul zhing /

mkha' lding gis klu brgyad bskul nas char med pa'i dus su stobs po che bsgom pa'i las sbyor gyis ni chu'i tshogs char ni dbab par bya'o/ /stobs po che kha dog gnag cing 'od zer cher gsal ba/ klu brgyad 'jigs pa'ang ni bya khyung 'jigs par mdzad/ phyag brgyad dang zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ phyag brgyad po rnams kyis ni klu yi bdag po mtha' yas la sogs pa brgyad po sngar gyi kha dog dang cha lugs bzhin bsnams pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ klu rnams kyi sa bon phuḥzhes bya ba'i sngags bzlos par bya shing / de yang / oṃ āḥdang hūm̐ gi nang du chud par byas te phaṭa ni phuḥde'i mtha' ru swāhā dang bcas pa sbyar bar bya ste/ oṃ āḥphuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā zhes pa'i sngags 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas te bsnyen pa bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhal bzhi'i dang po rtsa ba'i zhal ni kha dog nag po ste/ gnyis pa g.yas pa ni zla 'od bzang po nyid/ gsum pa g.yon zhal ni ser po'i mdog lta bu yin la/ bzhi pa rgyab zhal ni kha dog dmar po nyid du brjod/ sku la sbrul gyi rgyan gyis yang dag brgyan pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur te rdo rje sems dpa' dbu la rnam par brgyan no/ /lnga pa ni/ klu chen po brgyad rnams gzir cing bskul bas de rnams kyis ni char med pa'i dus su char dbab pa'i phyir stobs po che'i rnal 'byor ni rab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi de kho na nyid la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / de kho na nyid dngos dang / de kho na la gnas kyang ma grub na stobs kyis bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stobs po che'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'i rjes de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa de nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po'ang bskyed par mdzad pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'dzin pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud smra ba pos/
